statement: For strict finite posets P,Q of equal cardinality 1<=n<=7, equality of (F0,W_future,W_past) implies order-preserving isomorphism.
primary_endpoint: All residual unordered pairs under F0_W_both, without replacing the two scalar moments by the full paired degree multiset D.

conventions.C: Full strict transitive causal relation, not Hasse links; C[i][j]=1 iff i precedes j
conventions.polynomials: det(t I-M), monic integer coefficients in descending order
conventions.D: Sorted multiset of paired (strict_predecessor_count,strict_successor_count), diagnostic control only
conventions.isomorphism: Direction-preserving bijection. Time reversal is not imposed as an equivalence.
conventions.encoding: A row is an n-character bit string with column index increasing left to right; canonical integer code is sum(row_bitmask[i] << (n*i)). Canonicalization orders degree classes and minimizes over every within-class permutation.

population.note: Count agreement alone is not the completeness argument. Exhaustive independent classification and exact-once coverage are required.

methods.producer_enumeration: Adjoin a maximal point to every smaller isomorphism representative, for every order ideal as its strict past; exact degree-partition canonicalization.
methods.counter_enumeration: Every upper-triangular binary relation for each n; reject precisely the nontransitive relations; classify by directed backtracking bijections, without importing producer algorithms.
methods.multiplicity_crosscheck: Producer computes linear extensions by subset recursion and automorphisms by degree-class permutations; counter enumerator independently counts natural labellings per representative and checks L(P)/Aut(P). Counterchecker also counts every automorphism by directed backtracking and checks linear extensions as natural multiplicity times automorphisms.
methods.producer_polynomials: Faddeev-LeVerrier integer recurrence and Cayley-Hamilton residual
methods.counter_polynomials: Pivoted Bareiss determinants at n+1 integers, exact rational Newton interpolation
methods.counter_moments: Explicit directed fork triple counts, independently of the degree-moment formula
methods.collision_checks: Reconstruct every signature class independently; check every residual pair is nonisomorphic; retain complete matrices, exact invariants and duality status.

decisions.SUPPORTED_FINITE_N_LE_7: Complete counter-verified corpus and zero residual F0_W_both pairs for every n<=7
decisions.REFUTED_BY_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Complete counter-verified corpus and at least one nonisomorphic residual F0_W_both pair
decisions.INCONCLUSIVE: Timeout, incomplete enumeration, disagreement, invalid record or failed rejection control. Never report a completed hypothesis test.

reporting.numerical_tolerances: None; all primary comparisons use exact integers or rational arithmetic
reporting.discovery_status: The complete n=7 result was not computed before this protocol. Existing n<=6 and n=7 height<=2 results and n=8 counterexamples were already known. This is a workflow-local prospective freeze, not an external preregistration service.
